ao.label: Arctic Oscillation
ao.description: Negative = polar vortex weakens, cold/stormy air invades Midwest

nao.label: North Atlantic Oscillation
nao.description: Negative NAO shifts storm track southward toward the US

pdo.label: Pacific Decadal Oscillation
pdo.description: Positive PDO amplifies El Nino moisture patterns over North America

amo.label: Atlantic Multidecadal Oscillation
amo.description: Warm Atlantic SST increases moisture available for Midwest storms

gulf_sst.label: Gulf of Mexico SST
gulf_sst.description: Warmer Gulf increases moisture available for the low-level jet feeding Chicago

tpw.label: Surface Relative Humidity
tpw.description: High surface humidity means the atmosphere is close to saturation and rain-ready

z500.label: 500mb Geopotential Height
z500.description: Low 500mb heights = upper-level trough = storm-favorable pattern over Chicago
